hints.title: Circular Offset Rule
hints.text: Notice that moving nums[i] steps circularly from index i corresponds to adding nums[i] modulo n.

hints.title: Modulo Arithmetic
hints.text: Calculate target index as (i + nums[i]) % n, adjusting for negative indices by adding n before modulo.

hints.title: Array Construction
hints.text: Populate each output index with the element located at the computed circular index.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct calculation of target circular index using modulo arithmetic.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Single pass simulation is directly optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary memory beyond the output array.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies modular arithmetic properly handling negative circular wrap-around.
